sources: Iron Press design system: tokens.css (warm paper/ink palette, one saffron accent, Fraunces + JetBrains Mono, a paper-grain body::before texture)
Iron Press brand rules (prose): editorial brutalism, type does the work, never pie, omit icons, one chart max

dropped.signal: Paper-grain texture: a body::before radial overlay in Iron Press's tokens.css
dropped.reason: The :root-only restricted subset validateThemeCss accepts carries no pseudo-element rules, so a body::before overlay cannot travel through it.

judgementCalls.decision: Reserve saffron for attention states (--tone-negative, --tone-warning); carry positive and info on quiet ink shades.
judgementCalls.rationale: Iron Press has no semantic palette: one accent only, with differentiation through type and rules. A single saffron cannot mean both good and bad, so it goes to what genuinely demands attention while positive and info stay understated ink.

judgementCalls.decision: Synthesise the eight-colour chart ramp as ink (series 1), saffron highlight (series 2), then a neutral walk down the ink-to-paper tints; cap charts at two series in the brief.
judgementCalls.rationale: A one-accent system has no eight-colour categorical palette. Walking the neutral ramp with the accent as the series-2 highlight keeps two series legible, and the DESIGN.md caps charts at two series so the fading tail rarely renders.

judgementCalls.decision: Emit Iron Press's documented fallback stacks (Charter/Georgia for the Fraunces serif role, SF Mono/Consolas for JetBrains Mono) rather than loading the brand web fonts.
judgementCalls.rationale: url() and @font-face are rejected by the validator, so brand faces render only if installed on the host; the documented fallbacks carry the look everywhere else. applyHostFonts via the MCP Apps host context is the eventual proper channel for the brand faces.

judgementCalls.decision: Put ink text on the saffron --primary (--primary-foreground: #1c1611) instead of cream.
judgementCalls.rationale: Cream on saffron reads 2.8:1, below the 3:1 floor the theme lint enforces for text pairs. Iron Press differentiates with ink, so saffron surfaces carry ink text at 5.0:1. Mirrors the JUDGEMENT CALL comment in weave-theme.css.

judgementCalls.decision: Route uppercase overlines and labels onto the mono face via --weave-font-overline.
judgementCalls.rationale: Iron Press's overlines run in JetBrains Mono, not the Fraunces serif; uppercase belongs to the mono. The v3 per-role routing token pulls labels and table headers onto the mono while titles and body stay serif.

judgementCalls.decision: Set --weave-font-numeric to the Fraunces serif and --weave-font-feature-numeric to "onum" 1 (oldstyle figures).
judgementCalls.rationale: Numeric displays stay on the editorial serif with oldstyle figures, visibly distinct from the primitives' hardcoded tabular-nums baseline. Setting the numeric routing token explicitly exercises it end to end rather than via its fallback.
